# agentic-postcard

Send postcards through print vendors from CLI, code, or MCP.

Keywords: postcards, direct-mail, lob, postgrid, agentic-suite, claude-code, codex, cli, mcp.

- SDK: import { sendPostcard, trackPostcard } from "agentic-postcard".
- CLI: agentic-postcard send --to ... --message "...".
- MCP: run agentic-postcard mcp, then call send_postcard.

## Docs
